categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the software and information technology services sector focused on the new energy industry. Its main business segments include new energy power generation forecasting products, new energy grid-connected intelligent control systems, power grid new energy management systems, power trading products, smart energy storage management systems, virtual power plants, microgrid energy management systems, and new energy power station intelligent operation systems. These segments cover the entire new energy power management chain including generation, grid, load, and storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced meteorological data processing, AI-driven power forecasting algorithms, and intelligent control technologies such as automatic generation control (AGC), automatic voltage control (AVC), and active support devices. It integrates multi-source weather data, deep learning, and machine learning models, including proprietary AI large models like the 'Kuangming' new energy model, to enhance forecasting accuracy and grid management. The production methods include software development, hardware integration for power forecasting systems, and cloud-based energy management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include new energy power stations (wind and photovoltaic), power generation groups, grid companies such as State Grid and China Southern Power Grid, and power market participants including power trading companies and industrial users. The company serves the entire new energy ecosystem, providing products and services to support power generation forecasting, grid integration, energy storage, and market trading.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing with operations and sales covering all major regions of China including Northwest, North China, East China, Central China, Southwest, South China, Northeast, and expanding overseas markets such as Central Asia, Southeast Asia, Africa, Northern Europe, and South America. It has subsidiaries and projects across multiple provinces and cities in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the new energy supply chain, focusing on software and information technology services that enable power generation forecasting, grid integration, energy management, and power trading. It provides critical data and control systems that support upstream power generation assets and downstream grid and market operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in AI-driven meteorological and power forecasting models, enhancement of intelligent control systems, expansion of power trading and virtual power plant capabilities, and development of integrated energy management platforms covering source-grid-load-storage. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI large models, multi-scale forecasting, grid-edge computing, and digital twin technologies to support the evolving new energy market and regulatory environment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales including hardware and software systems, and service fees from data services and operational management. The company employs a SaaS-like subscription model for power forecasting and data services, and contracts for operation and maintenance services in virtual power plants, microgrids, and energy storage. It also earns revenue from consulting, system upgrades, and integrated energy solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the new energy power forecasting market in China, holding a dominant market share with over 4,300 power stations served. It maintains a competitive edge through superior forecasting accuracy, comprehensive product offerings, and strong customer relationships with major grid companies and power generation groups. Competitors include other specialized software and technology providers in the new energy and smart grid sectors, but the company’s integrated solutions and AI capabilities position it as a market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 550 million, a 20.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 93.6 million, up 11.1%. Total assets reached RMB 1.79 billion, growing 28.3% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth driven by expanding customer base, product innovation, and market penetration, with strong cash flow from operations and ongoing investments in R&D and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, AI-enhanced power forecasting and intelligent control systems that enable efficient integration and consumption of renewable energy. Its products support compliance with stringent regulatory standards and market mechanisms, reducing curtailment of renewable power and improving grid stability. The integrated 'source-grid-load-storage' management approach, combined with advanced AI models and comprehensive service capabilities, differentiates the company by delivering superior forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and market adaptability.
